title: Agent runtime: Claude Code in an embedded pty in the project folder, skills shipped safely, first message, tab metadata, waiting dot
story: Grillo can now start a member's own Claude Code inside the project folder in an embedded terminal. It copies its grillo-* skills in first, keeping them out of git and never overwriting a copy the project tracks, waits for Claude Code's input box so the folder-trust question stays the member's choice, then types the first message. The terminal tab that shows this comes in a later story; before this no agent could be started at all.

checks.criterion: Grillo starts Claude Code in the project folder and types the first message, then Enter, once the prompt appears
checks.steps: Install Claude Code and sign in. git init a made-up project folder. In Grillo, start a grilling agent on a made-up ticket 'Login flow' for that folder. If asked whether you trust the folder, choose 'Yes, I trust this folder'.
checks.expected: Claude Code's screen in the tab; the first message appears only after the trust question, is sent without pressing Enter, and Claude starts answering.

checks.criterion: grillo-* skills are copied into <folder>/.claude/skills/ on every start, tracked files never overwritten, copies kept out of git, no CLAUDE.md written
checks.steps: In the made-up project, commit .claude/skills/grillo-<any shipped skill>/SKILL.md with the text 'project copy'. Start an agent on that folder. Run git status and open .git/info/exclude.
checks.expected: The committed file still says 'project copy' and a warning naming it is logged; other skill files present; git status clean; .git/info/exclude lists /.claude/skills/grillo-*/ once per skill; no new CLAUDE.md.

checks.criterion: The tab is named '<kind> · <ticket>' and shows the waiting dot after 3 seconds of silence; the dot clears on the next output
checks.steps: Start a grilling agent for the made-up ticket 'Login flow'. Wait until Claude finishes replying. Type a message.
checks.expected: The tab reads 'Grilling · Login flow'; the dot appears about 3 seconds after output stops and disappears when Claude prints again.

checks.criterion: Several agents run at once, and stopping one leaves the others running
checks.steps: Start three agents (grilling, research, generic) on the made-up project. Stop the research agent.
checks.expected: The research tab goes away; the other two keep running and respond to typing.

checks.criterion: A clear error appears when claude is not on PATH
checks.steps: Launch Grillo with a PATH that has no claude on it. Start any agent.
checks.expected: The message 'Claude Code was not found: there is no `claude` command on PATH. Install Claude Code, sign in with your Claude subscription, then start the agent again.'; no agent starts.
